text_block_list.text: One day after training during the camp—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Gold City-senpai!
It was super pretty, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Standing there all alone, gazing at the sea...
Even in a tracksuit, she looked straight out of a painting!
As expected of a real model~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Miss City,
you're alone right now, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Are you going to go talk to them?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer! Please give me courage!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san is truly someone I look up to.
Just talking to her still gets me all nervous sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And yet here I am, presumptuous as ever,
about to call out to her. So...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: One more bid!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ye kindly!
Off I go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Wah.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Her hair illuminated by the setting sun...
It truly is "beautiful," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...That's enough of that,
already.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino is
really amazing, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You had to know, didn't you?
That reality doesn't always go the way you want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Believing that skill is everything.
Believing that feelings, gazes, everything...
would change as long as I kept running...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Except that's not true.
I'm the only one wishing things could change.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Then continuing to run is meaningless. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you carry yourself with even more confidence than before.
You know who you are. It's truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing.
There's no way I could...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: P-Please spare meee!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, Yukino...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna hear you whining,
City-san!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because City-san is
just freakin' incredible!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because you've always, always been
the "City girl" of my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I... never really had a sense of self.
Running was just... if it could become my one strong point, maybe I'd keep at it. That was all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That was when I learned about you, City-san.
You inside those magazines were...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She was so sparkly and dazzling!
Knowing an Umamusume like that existed,
I looked up to her right away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You
were my very first dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Even without you, Trainer...
I think I still would've come to Tokyo and run."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Work reasonably hard,
and be satisfied with results within one's limits.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, with no dream in sight,
I never gritted my teeth and stood my ground.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then... I'll return home in triumph,
and everyone will tell me I did a great job.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I reckon she just went back home after that and lived happily ever after.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Being cherished by everyone...
I'm so crazy happy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though...
Right now, I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I found a dream.
A place I want to stay, even if I have to dig deep and fight for it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why right now,
I believe in myself this much."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san gave all of this to me.
She told me to come to this sparkling world,
and brought me all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what kind of worries ya got, but...
from where I'm standing, City-san, you're one seriously cool Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, sorry 'bout that.
My words might've been a total mess."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So... in the end,
what I wanted to say was... umm.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san...
Let's run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Becoming who you want to be, and getting
everyone to love that version of you...
It's crazy, crazy hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“Still... don't you think I'd end up
hating myself even more if I didn't run?”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Because... I've already discovered the person I truly want to become.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let us have faith.
Shall we not try to believe just a little more... just one more step?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Because I'm sure that someday, we'll absolutely come to love ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You really are...
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry,
you had to see me look so lame."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm not looking at all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even when you're troubled, City-san...
whatever you do, you're just so cool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You'll always be so cool—
